verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the online filing rails run through an account: patents are entered via "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" (cipo-supp-2, cipo-docs-13). The trademark "Apply for/amend" online service (cipo-supp-1) is not documented as offering a keyless or file-number entry path. Keyless public patent search is an adjacent feature, not the core filing flow, so it earns no credit.
